component.name: AnduinOS Waypoint
component.summary: Recover AnduinOS and restore deleted Personal Files
恢复 AnduinOS 并找回误删的个人文件

description.p: AnduinOS Waypoint creates immutable Btrfs system recovery points and presents their package, file, space, and timeline information in a native GTK interface.

A restore creates a new writable deployment, retains a known-good fallback, and uses a verified one-shot GRUB entry. Recovery points can also be exported to and verified on supported external filesystems.
Independent Personal Files history snapshots the @home subvolume on a separate schedule. Users can browse earlier versions and recover files or folders without rolling back the operating system.
Automatic schedules can show desktop notifications after successful creation, while retention cleanup is reported as one quiet aggregate notification.
AnduinOS Waypoint 创建不可变的 Btrfs 系统恢复点，并通过原生 GTK 界面展示软件包、文件、空间和时间线信息。
恢复操作会创建新的可写部署、保留已知正常的回退部署，并使用经过验证的一次性 GRUB 启动项。恢复点还可导出到受支持的外部文件系统并进行验证。
独立的个人文件历史按单独计划为 @home 子卷创建快照。用户无需回滚操作系统，即可浏览早期版本并恢复文件或文件夹。
自动计划可在成功创建后显示桌面通知，保留策略清理则通过一条低干扰的汇总通知报告。
